text: Westport Albion moves quickly from right to left after Marek Zielinski intercepts the ball near the right side of his own half. Jonah Valdez carries the ball forward into the final third, reaching about 6 metres from the Kingsmoor goal near the centre. Dylan Rahman crosses the ball from the left flank to Valdez, who heads it toward goal. Westport Albion’s goalkeeper Tariq Brennan makes a fine save to keep the score at 3-2 in favor of Westport Albion. [#1464] [#1469] [#1470] [#1471]
